quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #19
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 16

questions.question: Your license may be suspended for:

options.text: Driving in violation of license restrictions.
Repeated violations of motor vehicle laws.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of these.
questions.explanation: Breaking motor vehicle laws and getting points on your driving record can result in a suspended or revoked license.

questions.question: It is illegal to park within ____ of a fire hydrant.
questions.correctAnswerText: 15 feet
questions.explanation: You cannot park within 15 feet of a fire hydrant.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.
The road curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: You are waiting in the intersection to turn left. You should:

options.text: Signal and turn your wheels left.
Signal and keep your wheels straight.
Flash your headlights so drivers will let you through.
Drive around the rear of a car blocking you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal and keep your wheels straight.
questions.explanation: Always signal before turning or changing lanes. Keep your wheels straight while waiting to turn left. If a car hits you from behind, this prevents you from being pushed into oncoming traffic.

questions.question: You are approaching a railroad crossing with a crossbuck sign but no gates or flashing lights. You should:

options.text: Approach with extreme caution and cross only when you know no train is coming.
Turn your radio down to listen for an approaching train.
Only continue if a flagger signals you to go.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Approach all railroad crossings with extreme caution. Cross only when you are sure no train is coming from either direction. If a flagger is present, obey all their directions.

questions.question: The traffic light turns yellow as you enter the intersection. You should:
questions.correctAnswerText: Pass through carefully.
questions.explanation: When the light turns yellow, slow down and prepare to stop. If you are already in the intersection or too close to stop safely, you may proceed through with extreme caution.

questions.question: To prevent fatigue on a long trip, you should:

options.text: Stop and rest every two hours.
Drive with one eye open at a time.
Change feet on the gas pedal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and rest every two hours.
questions.explanation: Stop every two hours for a short break during long trips to avoid fatigue. If you become drowsy, pull over safely to rest or find a place to stay for the night.

questions.question: To safely pass a bicycle, you should:

options.text: Honk to let the cyclist know you are passing.
Drive in the bicycle lane until you can pass.
Slow down and give them as much space as possible.
Rush ahead to pull in front of the bicycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and give them as much space as possible.
questions.explanation: Slow down when passing a bicycle and give them plenty of space. Cyclists have less protection than drivers and need room. Passing too quickly can cause them to lose control.

questions.question: The "No zone" is:

options.text: The blind spots around a truck or bus.
A roadway with restrictions on stereo volume.
The TV show that replaced The Twilight Zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spots around a truck or bus.
questions.explanation: Trucks and buses have blind spots on the sides, rear, and front. Cars cannot be seen in these areas. These blind spots are called the "No zone."

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: Steep downgrade.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for road hazards. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Adjust your speed to avoid brake damage or crashes.

questions.question: When a driver behind you wants to pass, what should you do?

options.text: Slow down to give the other driver room to pass safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to give the other driver room to pass safely.
questions.explanation: When a driver behind you wants to pass, slow down. This gives them more room in front of your vehicle to complete the pass quickly and safely.

questions.question: You see a red traffic light flashing. What should you do?

options.text: Go only when it is safe.
Treat it like a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of these.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. Stop completely behind the stop line. Look both ways for traffic and pedestrians. Go only when it is safe.

questions.question: When can you park or stop on the side of a freeway?

options.text: If you use your emergency flashers.
If your vehicle is completely off the road.
If you need to read a map.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only in an emergency.
questions.explanation: You cannot park on the side of a freeway except in an emergency.

questions.question: How can you stay out of a truck or bus driver's blind spot?

options.text: Do not drive next to them and do not tailgate them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not drive next to them and do not tailgate them.
questions.explanation: Large trucks and buses have large blind spots on the sides and rear. Do not drive alongside them and do not follow too closely behind them.

questions.question: Within 15 days of a crash, when must you show proof of insurance to the DMV?

options.text: Only if property damage is more than $2,000.
If someone is hurt, killed, or property damage is $501 or more.
Only if property damage is more than $1,000.
Only if someone is hurt or killed.

questions.correctAnswerText: If someone is hurt, killed, or property damage is $501 or more.
questions.explanation: You must provide proof of insurance to the DMV within 15 days if the crash caused injury, death, or property damage of $501 or more. All drivers involved must provide proof, no matter who caused the crash.

questions.question: An orange triangle with red borders on the back of a vehicle means what?
questions.correctAnswerText: It is a slow-moving vehicle.
questions.explanation: An orange triangle with red borders shows that a vehicle is slow-moving. Do not expect it to go faster than 25 mph.

questions.question: What headlights should you use when driving in fog?
questions.correctAnswerText: Low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog, along with fog lights if you have them. High beams bounce off the fog and back into your eyes, making it harder to see.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow traffic light mean?

options.text: Keep going at your current speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be careful.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and look both ways. Let any traffic or pedestrians already in the intersection go first.

questions.question: If your vehicle starts to skid, what should you do?

options.text: Turn sharply in the opposite direction.
Turn your wheel in the direction the vehicle is skidding.
Let go of the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your wheel in the direction the vehicle is skidding.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle skids, stay calm. Steer in the same direction the vehicle is skidding.

questions.question: How can you avoid getting sleepy on long trips?

options.text: Stop regularly to rest and stretch.
Move your eyes side to side while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop regularly to rest and stretch.
questions.explanation: On long trips, stop regularly to rest and stretch. Do this even if you do not feel tired yet.
